WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
        AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) AS kam_sme_diff

WITH customer_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        ym.CustomerID,
        MIN(ym.Consumption) as min_consumption

    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_averages AS (

        Segment,
        AVG(min_consumption) as avg_min_consumption
    FROM customer_min_consumption

SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -

    (SELECT avg_min_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -

WITH customer_transaction AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        yt.CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN yt.Date >= 201201 AND yt.Date <= 201212 THEN yt.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN yt.Date >= 201301 AND yt.Date <= 201312 THEN yt.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth yt
    JOIN customer_transaction ct ON yt.CustomerID = ct.CustomerID
    GROUP BY yt.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM customer_consumption
WHERE consumption_2012 > 0

WITH customer_payment AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        CAST(SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        Consumption
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM customer_payment)
    AND CAST(SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) IN (2012, 2013)
)
SELECT 
    (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN Consumption END) - 
     MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN Consumption END)) / 
    MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN Consumption END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM consumption_data
